title: Discover
description: Talk through the goal, the users and the deadline, then agree on a scope that is small enough to ship.

title: Design
description: Sketch the screens and the data model together, so surprises show up on paper instead of in production.

title: Build
description: Work in short iterations with a working preview, using reusable components and a typed API from the start.

title: Launch
description: Test the critical flows, set up Docker and CI/CD, and deploy so every later release is one merge away.

title: Support
description: Stay available after launch for fixes, handover notes and the next round of improvements.
